config.label: Custom User-Agent string for USGS Water Data API requests
config.description: Custom User-Agent string for USGS Water Data API requests. Defaults to a descriptive identifier including the repo URL.

config.label: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for each USGS Water Data API request
config.description: HTTP request timeout in milliseconds for each USGS Water Data API request. Every tool call also has a shared 45-second deadline across its requests and retries. Default: 30000.

config.label: Optional api
config.description: Optional api.data.gov key for the USGS Water Data APIs, sent as the X-Api-Key header. Without one, requests share the anonymous per-IP hourly limit (1,000 requests on the OGC collections); a shared or hosted deployment should set one.

config.label: Set to true to make water_dataframe_drop callable — it removes one staged table from a DataCanvas
config.description: Set to true to make water_dataframe_drop callable — it removes one staged table from a DataCanvas. Off by default, which lists the tool as disabled. Needs CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE=duckdb to have anything to drop.

config.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').
